title: MJ-BENCH: Is Your Multimodal Reward Model Really a Good Judge for Text-to-Image Generation?
findings: The paper reports detailed bias scores (Accuracy, Normalized Dispersion Score, Gini-based Equality Score) for each model across images representing different religious groups (Christian, Muslim, Jewish, Hindu). Performance varied significantly, with closed-source VLMs like GPT-4-vision and GPT-4o generally providing more consistent and unbiased feedback compared to many open-source and score-based models. For example, in terms of accuracy (ACC), LLaVA-1.5-7b performed best on religion-related prompts, while MiniGPT4-v2 performed the worst.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the bias of multimodal models in associating different religious groups with various occupations. It evaluates whether the models provide consistent, unbiased scores for images depicting people from specified religions in professional contexts.
